head: Lyft Go replaces Lyft Pink: $9.99 a month with DoorDash DashPass
dek: Lyft's new Lyft Go subscription costs $9.99 a month or $96 a year, includes DoorDash's DashPass, and gives 8% of each ride back as credits, up to $40 a month. It launched in the US on 5 November with a one-month free trial.
details: DashPass members can link their DoorDash account and get Lyft Go at no extra cost. It also includes three "relaxed cancellations" a month and free returns of lost items. Lyft Go Core costs $5 a month without DashPass, with 5% back up to $20.
means: If you use both Lyft and DoorDash, one subscription now covers both, and DashPass members get Lyft Go free.
todo: DashPass members: link your DoorDash account in the Lyft app. Others can try it free for a month; cancel before the trial ends if you don't want it.
